description: Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B on one DGX Spark with KindlingAI's gr8, a from-scratch CUDA inference engine (no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time), at tensor parallel 1. The weights are KindlingAI's calibrated exlr8-v2 K4 release at revision 7f98ec79 (1.34 GB), served by gr8's g6embed engine and its Rust front end on POST /v1/embeddings: 2048-dimension vectors, Matryoshka truncation to any size from 1 up to 2048 through the request's dimensions field (the creator measures 64 to 2048), float or base64 output, and a sequence limit of 16,384 tokens. The recipe runs the creator's published image (gr8 v1.5.0 at dd253a4f, by digest) with a placement wrapper that uses the release in place from the read-only model mounts and keeps gr8's working files under /outputs/cache/gr8. The gateway route takes text input only: the model and the engine also embed images through a vLLM-style messages field, but the gateway's /v1/embeddings carries no image path yet, so image input is declared off. Creator claims, unmeasured here: 2.61 GiB GPU peak. Licences, for information: the weights are Apache-2.0; the engine and recipe are MIT.
title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding 2B EXLR8 gr8 one Spark
